sentences.japanese: 我々は暴力に訴えるべきでない。
sentences.english: We should not resort to violence.

sentences.japanese: もし彼らが花瓶を見つけていなければ、ジョンは窃盗罪で訴えられていただろう。
sentences.english: If they hadn't found the vase, John would have been accused of stealing it.

sentences.japanese: ついに学生たちは暴力に訴えた。
sentences.english: At last, the students resorted to violence.

sentences.japanese: たいへん驚いたことに、私の歌は大勢の若者の心に訴えた。
sentences.english: Much to my surprise, my song appealed to many young people.

sentences.japanese: そんな恐ろしい行為に訴えた時、その若者は大変絶望的になっていたに違いない。
sentences.english: The young man must have felt very desperate when he resorted to such a terrible act.
